stories.title: Opposition alliance calls in Flintshire Cabinet decision to revive Catholic super-school plan
stories.summary: An alliance of opposition councillors has formally challenged Flintshire’s Cabinet over it’s plans to bring back unchanged its controversial Catholic super-school plans. stories.title: Heading into Chester this summer? Here is what police are doing to keep people safe
stories.summary: Cheshire Police have launched a summer safety campaign in Chester targeting drugs, disorderly behaviour and violence against women and girls. The campaign, called Keeping Chester Safe – With you. For you, was launched on Tuesday 19 May ahead of the Chester race season and the city’s busiest summer weekends. stories.title: North Wales PCC welcomes £30m UK crackdown on organised crime in high street shops
stories.summary: The North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin has welcomed a £30 million UK Government crackdown on organised crime in high street shops. stories.title: Sponsorship sign applications submitted for around 20 Flintshire roundabouts
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been asked to approve sponsorship signs at around 20 roundabouts across the county. The applications are part of the council’s Roundabout Portfolio Sponsorship scheme, which the council says is managed on its behalf by Outdo Media, an outdoor advertising company.
